title: 实木家具材质与工艺术语

intro.visual: 樟子松纹理 + 封边工艺 + 水性涂料
intro.background: 温尚幼儿园家具的核心卖点是实木、环保、安全。我们的主力材是樟子松（Pinus sylvestris var. mongolica），纹理细直、天然防蛀、能吸收空气中的有害物质。封边用德国汉高环保胶水，饰面用FORMICA防火板，表面涂水性涂料——无毒、无异味、可降解。客户问得最多的就是：什么木？E0还是E1？表面是PU漆还是水性涂料？圆角多少毫米？这些你必须能用英语对答如流。
intro.desc: 掌握温尚实际使用的木材、胶水、饰面、涂料及安全工艺的英语表达。
tasks: 认识樟子松等4种常用木材及特性
区分汉高胶水/FORMICA饰面/水性涂料3种工艺
掌握物理/化学/结构三重安全术语
outcomes: 能用英语介绍樟子松材质优势
能回答客户环保等级和涂料问题
能描述封边、饰面等工艺细节

oneLiner.en: When a buyer asks what wood it is, answer with species, glue, finish and certification — not just solid wood. We use Mongolian Scotch pine with Henkel glue and waterborne coating.
oneLiner.cn: 客户问什么木时，要回答树种、胶水、饰面和认证——不能只说实木。我们用樟子松+汉高胶水+水性涂料。

vocab.ex: Our furniture is made of natural Mongolian Scotch pine with fine straight grain.
vocab.exCn: 我们的家具用天然樟子松，纹理细直。

vocab.ex: We use German Henkel environmental glue for edge banding — it bonds firmly and lasts longer.
vocab.exCn: 封边用德国汉高环保胶水，粘合更牢固持久。

vocab.ex: FORMICA veneer protection enhances waterproof, stain-resistant and scratch-resistant performance.
vocab.exCn: FORMICA饰面增强防水、防污、抗划伤性能。

vocab.ex: Our waterborne coating is non-toxic, odorless, biodegradable and recyclable.
vocab.exCn: 我们的水性涂料无毒、无味、可降解、可回收。

vocab.ex: The edge banding strip keeps its integrity in daily use thanks to Henkel glue.
vocab.exCn: 汉高胶水让封边条在日常使用中保持完整。

vocab.ex: Our plywood meets E0 formaldehyde emission standards — free of six phthalates and PAHs.
vocab.exCn: 我们的胶合板达到E0甲醛标准——不含六大邻苯和多环芳烃。

vocab.ex: All edges are routed to a 3mm radius with softened corners for child safety.
vocab.exCn: 所有边缘倒3mm圆角，保障儿童安全。

vocab.ex: Scotch pine naturally absorbs harmful substances in the air and has strong moth-proof and moisture-proof effects.
vocab.exCn: 樟子松天然吸收空气中有害物质，防蛀防潮效果强。

mistakes.wrong: It is solid wood and very safe.
mistakes.right: It is made of natural Mongolian Scotch pine, edge-banded with German Henkel glue, finished with waterborne coating, E0 grade, with all edges rounded to 3mm radius.
mistakes.cn: 错误：只说实木和安全。客户要的是具体树种、胶水品牌、涂料类型、环保等级和圆角参数。

mistakes.right: Our waterborne coating is non-toxic, odorless and biodegradable. Lead and heavy metal content meet international standards, free of six major ortho benzene and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons.
mistakes.cn: 错误：只说环保漆。要具体说明水性涂料的无毒、无异味、可降解、重金属达标、不含邻苯和多环芳烃。

basic.en: The edge banding uses German Henkel environmental glue.
basic.cn: 封边用德国汉高环保胶水。

basic.en: The surface is protected by FORMICA veneer.
We apply waterborne coating — non-toxic and odorless.
basic.cn: 我们用水性涂料——无毒无味。

basic.cn: 所有边缘倒3mm圆角保证安全。

advanced.en: Our kindergarten furniture is crafted from natural Mongolian Scotch pine — fine straight grain, naturally moth-proof and moisture-absorbent. Edge banding uses German Henkel environmental glue for lasting bond strength, and the surface is finished with waterborne coating that is non-toxic, biodegradable and free of six phthalates and PAHs — fully E0 grade and EN71-3 certified.
advanced.cn: 我们的幼儿园家具采用天然樟子松——纹理细直、天然防蛀吸湿。封边用德国汉高环保胶水确保持久粘合，表面涂水性涂料——无毒、可降解、不含六大邻苯和多环芳烃——全项E0级并通过EN71-3认证。
advanced.from: We use natural Mongolian Scotch pine for the furniture.

advanced.en: Every board edge is routed to a 3mm radius with softened corners, all hardware is child-proof and recessed, and hole-and-gap spacing complies with EN1176 anti-entrapment requirements — structural safety is engineered, not just claimed.
advanced.cn: 每块板边缘倒3mm圆角，五金件儿童防误触并嵌入式安装，孔洞缝隙间距符合EN1176防夹要求——结构安全是设计出来的，不是嘴上说的。
advanced.from: All edges are rounded to 3mm radius for safety.

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: What wood do you use? And what kind of paint? We are very strict about chemicals.
lines.cn: 你们用什么木？什么漆？我们对化学品要求很严。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: We use natural Mongolian Scotch pine — it has fine straight grain and is naturally moth-proof. The surface is waterborne coating, non-toxic and odorless. Lead and heavy metals meet international standards, no phthalates or PAHs. We can provide the test report.
lines.cn: 我们用天然樟子松——纹理细直、天然防蛀。表面是水性涂料，无毒无味。铅和重金属达标，不含邻苯和多环芳烃。可以提供检测报告。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: What about the edge banding? Does it peel off after a year?
lines.cn: 封边呢？一年后会脱落吗？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: We use German Henkel environmental glue for edge banding. It bonds more firmly and durably than ordinary glue. The edge sealing strip keeps its integrity in daily use. We have clients using it for over 5 years without peeling.
lines.cn: 我们用德国汉高环保胶水封边，比普通胶水粘合更牢固持久。封边条在日常使用中保持完整。有客户用了5年以上没有脱落。

scenario.q: A German kindergarten buyer asks: what materials do you use and how do you guarantee safety? Give a complete professional answer.
scenario.modelAnswer: We use natural Mongolian Scotch pine for the main structure — fine grain, naturally moth-proof and moisture-resistant. Edge banding uses German Henkel environmental glue for lasting adhesion. The surface is FORMICA veneer protected with waterborne coating — non-toxic, odorless, biodegradable, free of six phthalates and PAHs. All panels are E0 grade, edges rounded to 3mm radius, hardware recessed and child-proof. We hold EN71-3 and CE certificates, and TUV test reports are available.
scenario.cn: 主体结构用天然樟子松——纹理细腻、天然防蛀防潮。封边用德国汉高环保胶水持久粘合。表面FORMICA饰面+水性涂料——无毒、无味、可降解、不含六大邻苯和多环芳烃。所有板材E0级，边缘倒3mm圆角，五金嵌入式防误触。持有EN71-3和CE认证，可提供TUV检测报告。

checklist: 我能说出樟子松的3个特性（纹理细直/防蛀/吸湿）
我能介绍汉高胶水和FORMICA饰面的作用
我能说明水性涂料的4个环保指标（无毒/无异味/可降解/重金属达标）
我能解释E0/E1甲醛等级差异
我能描述3mm圆角和嵌入式五金的安全设计
我能完整介绍材质+胶水+饰面+涂料+认证

culture.title: 欧洲客户为什么死磕环保认证
culture.content: 欧洲客户对儿童家具的环保要求近乎苛刻。原因有三：一是法律强制（EN71-3、CE、REACH）；二是家长会用检测笔扫家具；三是幼儿园招生时环保是核心卖点。报价时不要等客户问有没有E0，要主动写进方案：樟子松实木+汉高胶水+FORMICA饰面+水性涂料+E0胶合板+EN71-3报告。这是你和便宜小厂的差异化。颜色偏好：欧洲喜欢原木色、白色、浅灰；中东喜欢鲜艳饱和色；东南亚喜欢粉色、马卡龙色。

aiPractice.situation: 德国客户Emma询问温尚幼儿园家具的材质和环保工艺。
aiPractice.role: Emma Muller，德国幼教集团采购总监。

rounds.ai: What wood species do you use for your kindergarten furniture? We need something durable and natural.
rounds.cn: 你们的幼儿园家具用什么木种？我们需要耐用且天然的材料。
rounds.hint: 樟子松Mongolian Scotch pine，纹理细直，天然防蛀防潮。

rounds.ai: What kind of glue and paint do you use? We have very strict chemical standards in Germany.
rounds.cn: 你们用什么胶水和漆？德国化学品标准很严。
rounds.hint: 汉高环保胶水Henkel glue，水性涂料waterborne coating，无毒无异味，不含邻苯PAHs。

rounds.ai: Can you provide test reports? We need EN71-3 and CE certification for our compliance team.
rounds.cn: 能提供检测报告吗？我们合规团队需要EN71-3和CE认证。
rounds.hint: 确认有EN71-3/CE/TUV报告，随报价附上。
